catalogue.description: Reopens a finished quality inspection through the standard ReopenInspection action so test values can be changed again.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Reopens a finished quality inspection through the standard ReopenInspection action so test values can be changed again.

target.description: SystemId of the Qlty. Inspection Header to reopen.

parameters.name: inspectionSystemId
parameters.description: Non-empty SystemId GUID of an existing quality inspection. Unknown keys are refused before execution.

errors.when: inspectionSystemId is missing.
errors.fix: Supply the inspection SystemId.

errors.when: inspectionSystemId is not a non-empty GUID.
errors.fix: Supply a GUID.

errors.when: An undeclared data key was supplied.
errors.fix: Remove undeclared keys.

errors.when: The inspection does not exist or is not visible.
errors.fix: Read the inspection with Data.Records.Get.

errors.when: The app action permission is missing.
errors.fix: Ask an administrator for BIFROST QM Full ori.

errors.when: Standard Quality Management refused the reopen: the user is not Quality Admin & Supervisor or SUPER, a later re-inspection exists, or another native check failed. The translated message is returned and no partial status or quantity change remains.
errors.fix: Correct the native business condition before retrying.

errors.when: A transient lock or deadlock caught while writing or posting. The error preserves Business Central's original text. Uncaught errors are Retryable only for types with effect write.
errors.fix: Retry the same call after a few seconds; nothing was changed.

effect.changes: Calls Qlty. Inspection Header.ReopenInspection. It does not write Status, Pass Quantity or Fail Quantity directly. The standard action checks the admin role, errors when a later re-inspection exists, and when the inspection is Finished and the non-interactive session proceeds (or the user confirms), validates Status to Open. On this Business Central version the procedure then Modify(true), and the persisted result is Status Open with the pass and fail quantities that were already stored. An already open inspection is left unchanged. There is no Commit on this path. Explicit subscriber commits are rejected. Normal task success commits; a business error rolls back.
preconditions: The caller has BIFROST QM Full ori.
Microsoft ReopenInspection requires the Quality Admin & Supervisor role, or SUPER, assigned to the user. Included permission sets do not satisfy that check.
No later re-inspection exists for the same inspection number.
